scope: Casts/attacks require a queued-visible caster; damage/heal/hazard damage require a queued-visible recipient in the same scene, with an own-event exception after joined-scene validation.
Missing actor metadata and old-scene visible IDs fail closed; metadata and queued-snapshot cache access remain synchronized.
Initial or delta state-packet rejection invalidates snapshot/delta history; the next accepted packet fully replaces the state. Independently queued private endgame progress stays intact.
No changes to party kill/XP/quest credit, rewards, inventory, wallets, saves, raid/crystal notices or global announcement paths.
limits: Interest uses the last successfully queued actor snapshot, not transport acknowledgements or zero-latency live positions.
Actual production snapshot/delivery functions with synthetic recipients and queues, not a running network hub or new socket deployment proof.
No latest-source production binary, full encounter,100-player capacity, human art/device/pacing or1.72 release acceptance is implied.
Remaining worker bounds, jump range policy and connected route/load evidence remain open.
